cases.name: agent_provision
assertions: agent provision operation id remains ak.self.agent.command.provision
agent provision capability action matches the operation id
agent grants marked effective_after_first_authorized_key remain inactive before key pairing
missing accountability grants fail with accountability_grant_missing

cases.name: agent_pairing_expiry
assertions: agent key-pair operation id remains ak.gate.account.command.pair_agent_key
expired pairing requests fail with pairing_request_expired
DID mismatch, invalid proof, expired pairing, and deactivated agent errors are all pinned

cases.name: agent_controller_lifecycle
assertions: agent lifecycle operation ids retain canonical namespaces
active to paused to active to deactivated is accepted
deactivated is terminal and resume fails with agent_deactivated
pause while paused fails with agent_paused

cases.name: agent_act_on_behalf
assertions: controller approvals are single-use
approval replay fails with approval_already_consumed
act-on-behalf without authorization_ref, participation, matching grant scope, or fresh approval fails closed
unauthorised sidecar creation fails with sidecar_create_denied

cases.name: agent_session_grant_replay
assertions: session grant issue operation id remains ak.gate.account.command.issue_session_grant
agent_key_proof challenge replay, audience mismatch, and bad signature fail closed
agent session branch rejects invalid proofs, DID mismatch, paused agents, and deactivated agents
accountability grant absence is pinned as accountability_grant_missing

cases.name: agent_human_approval_required
assertions: error details validate against agent_human_approval_error_details
approval_request_id is opaque and is the only runtime-visible correlation handle
controller approval completes out of band
agent retry references accepted approval evidence
no interactive human challenge is returned to the agent runtime
